page_title: LOR 2-4 MAR | Lorient v Marseille 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
90+3' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game. One of the players from Lorient won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

89' Bonke Innocent (Lorient) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the right side of the goal, but Pau Lopez has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
87' The game has come to an end for Gedeon Kalulu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
86' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the corner with a short pass.
85' Renan Lodi (Marseille) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
85' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Eric Wattellier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Marseille have a free kick.
83' Substitution. Azzedine Ounahi makes his way off the pitch and Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
83' Substitution. Michael Murillo (Marseille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Vitinha walks off.
80' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
80' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) replaces Benjamin Mendy.
78' One of the Lorient players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
77' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
76' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
74' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) picks up an injury.
73' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang as he is replaced by Ismaila Sarr (Marseille).
72' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to substitute Amine Harit and he is replaced by Pape Gueye (Marseille).
71' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Formose Mendy (Lorient) for his blatant foul.
70' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' The substitution has been made. Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) has replaced Julien Ponceau.

65' That didn't go as planned! Laurent Abergel (Lorient) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Pau Lopez, who easily kept it out.
62' The game is interrupted. Bonke Innocent (Lorient) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
59' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Eric Wattellier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' Yellow card. Renan Lodi (Marseille) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
56' The referee signals a corner kick to Lorient.
56' A header by Montassar Talbi (Lorient) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Pau Lopez, who makes a brilliant save.
55' Renan Lodi (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
52' 2 - 4 Goal! Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:4.
52' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
50' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:5.
47' It will be a corner kick for Lorient.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) is replaced by Formose Mendy.
46' The referee signals a substitution. Isaak Toure (Lorient) is brought on as a substitute for Julien Laporte.
46' Referee Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Amine Harit (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call.
45+2' Julien Laporte (Lorient) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
45+1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted now, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' 1 - 4 Goal! Jordan Veretout plays a pass to the feet of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 1:4.
41' 1 - 3 Goal! Romain Faivre (Lorient) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:3.
41' Romain Faivre (Lorient) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
40' Amine Harit (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle.
39' Renan Lodi (Marseille) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
37' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' 0 - 3 Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:3.
33' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) takes the corner.
33' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) gets inside the box and tries to beat Yvon Mvogo with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
32' Amine Harit (Marseille) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
30' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
28' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

27' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a quality pass inside the box and hits a first-time shot. His effort towards the top of the net is saved by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
26' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Pau Lopez anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.

25' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Bamba Dieng. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
22' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
22' Vitinha (Marseille) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lorient have a free kick.
21' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
21' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) forces a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
18' The corner is sent into the box by Benjamin Mendy, but Julien Laporte (Lorient) flashes the ball just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
18' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
18' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) passes the ball onto Benjamin Mendy, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) for his blatant foul.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' Vitinha (Marseille) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
12' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
11' There's an opportunity for Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

9' 0 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Chancel Mbemba is pounced on by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). His close-range strike flashes past Yvon Mvogo and into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
7' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Vitinha (Marseille).
6' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Jordan Veretout (Marseille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
3' 0 - 1 A nice goal by Chancel Mbemba (Marseille)! He coolly drilled a low shot deep inside the left post.
3' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
2' Rough tackle by Bamba Dieng (Lorient). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Marseille will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Eric Wattellier.
